resolve.title: Update tracking for "{mod}"
resolve.search_hint: Search GameBanana, or paste a mod page link
resolve.no_results: No mods found. Try a different name, or paste the mod page link.
resolve.paste_is_file_link: That link points at a file, not at a mod page. GameBanana cannot say which mod a file belongs to, so open the mod page and copy its address instead.
resolve.load_failed: Couldn't reach GameBanana. Check your connection and try again.
resolve.no_files: This mod page publishes no files.
resolve.settled: Matched exactly: the archive you installed is byte-identical to this file.
resolve.reason_date: newest file that existed when you installed this
resolve.also_fill_metadata: Also fill in the description, images and tags this mod is missing
resolve.dont_know_hint: Records the date instead — you'll be told about anything published after {date}.
resolve.dont_know_unavailable: Needs an install date, and none could be worked out for this mod.
resolve.not_gamebanana: Not from GameBanana, or it's my own
resolve.not_gamebanana_hint: Stops asking about this mod. You can turn it back on here later.
resolve.tracking_off: You marked this mod as your own, so it isn't checked for updates.
resolve.tracked_id_downloaded: You downloaded this mod from here.
resolve.tracked_id_confirmed: You confirmed this is the right mod page.
resolve.tracked_id_inferred: Worked out from the source link on this mod — not confirmed.
resolve.tracked_file_hash: byte-identical to the archive you installed
resolve.tracked_file_date_only: No file recorded — anything published after {date} counts as an update.

assume_current.title_single: Assume this mod is up to date?
assume_current.title_plural: Assume {count} mods are up to date?
assume_current.body: Each of them records the date it was installed instead of a version. From then on you'll be told about files published after that date, and nothing published before it.
assume_current.no_version: No version number is invented — this stays an honest "I don't know which file", and you can still set the exact file for any mod later.
assume_current.proxy_caveat: Most install dates are worked out from the oldest file in the mod's folder. If you copied mods into your library by hand, that date can read early, so you may be told about updates you already have.
assume_current.excluded_untracked_single: 1 more mod needs attention but isn't linked to a GameBanana page. It has to be linked on its own — a wrong match made in bulk could later overwrite a mod with a different mod's files.
assume_current.excluded_untracked_plural: {count} more mods need attention but aren't linked to a GameBanana page. Those have to be linked one at a time — a wrong match made in bulk could later overwrite a mod with a different mod's files.
assume_current.excluded_undatable_single: 1 mod is skipped: no install date could be worked out for it, so there is nothing to compare against.
assume_current.excluded_undatable_plural: {count} mods are skipped: no install date could be worked out for them, so there is nothing to compare against.
assume_current.done_single: 1 mod now watches for files published after its install date.
assume_current.done_plural: {count} mods now watch for files published after their install date.
assume_current.done_partial_body_single: Couldn't save tracking data for 1 more — its folder may be read-only.
assume_current.done_partial_body_plural: Couldn't save tracking data for {count} more — those folders may be read-only.
assume_current.already_done_single: That mod was already sorted out.
assume_current.already_done_plural: Those {count} mods were already sorted out.
assume_current.failed_single: One mod's folder may be read-only.

bulk_resolve.title: Sort out where these mods came from
bulk_resolve.intro: To tell you about updates, the app needs to know which GameBanana page each mod folder came from and which file you installed. Ticked boxes are what this check worked out on its own — untick anything that looks wrong. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
bulk_resolve.section_identity: Is this the right mod page? ({count})
bulk_resolve.section_identity_why: These folders were linked to a page by reading a link somebody pasted, and nobody has checked it since. Compare the folder name with the page name — an update is only ever offered once you have confirmed it.
bulk_resolve.section_version_why: Knowing the mod isn't enough: a page usually offers several files, and without knowing yours the app can't tell a newer version from a different variant.
bulk_resolve.section_gone_why: GameBanana reports these pages as private, deleted or withheld, so there is nothing left to check against. Recording it stops the app asking and marks the mod's card so you know why it went quiet.
bulk_resolve.section_back_why: These were recorded as gone, and GameBanana answered normally this time. Clearing the mark puts them back under normal update checks.
bulk_resolve.confirm_identity: Yes, this is the right mod page
bulk_resolve.record_source_gone: Record that this page is gone
bulk_resolve.record_source_back: Clear the mark on this mod
bulk_resolve.excluded_untracked_single: 1 mod isn't linked to a GameBanana page and can't be sorted out here. It has to be linked on its own — a wrong match made in bulk could later overwrite a mod with a different mod's files.
bulk_resolve.excluded_untracked_plural: {count} mods aren't linked to a GameBanana page and can't be sorted out here. Those have to be linked one at a time — a wrong match made in bulk could later overwrite a mod with a different mod's files.
bulk_resolve.already_known_single: 1 mod isn't listed: it's already sorted out, or you declared it your own.
bulk_resolve.already_known_plural: {count} mods aren't listed: they're already sorted out, or you declared them your own.
bulk_resolve.done_body: They'll be checked for updates from now on.
bulk_resolve.done_partial_body_single: Couldn't save it for 1 more — its folder may be read-only.
bulk_resolve.done_partial_body_plural: Couldn't save it for {count} more — those folders may be read-only.
bulk_resolve.already_done_single: That mod was already sorted out.
bulk_resolve.already_done_plural: Those {count} mods were already sorted out.
bulk_resolve.failed_single: One mod's folder may be read-only.

update.title: Updates — {mod}
update.verdict_version_unknown: Can't tell — no installed version on record
update.verdict_tracking_off: You marked this mod as your own
update.verdict_source_gone: The mod page is no longer available
update.verdict_indeterminate: The mod page listed no files
update.options_hint: This mod offers more than one file. We've marked the one we'd pick — you know which variant you installed, so check it before downloading.
update.no_successor: The file you installed is no longer offered, and nothing currently on the mod page is identifiably its replacement. Open the mod page to see what's there.
update.guess_caveat: Update checks are a best guess, not a guarantee — GameBanana publishes no comparable version numbers, so this rests on file labels and upload dates.
update.manual_note: “Update” downloads the file marked above and writes it over this mod's folder, keeping a copy of the current version first. Installing from the Marketplace instead adds a second mod folder alongside this one.
update.obsolete: The author has flagged this mod as superseded. It still exists and still downloads.
update.untracked_hint: Link this mod to a mod page first — use “Update tracking” from its right-click menu.
update.version_unknown_hint: Record which file you installed and this check can judge what comes back.
update.check_failed: Couldn't reach GameBanana. Check your connection and try again.
update.not_checked: This mod hasn't been checked yet.
update.bulk_none_partial: No updates among the mods we could check
update.launch_checked_single: Checked 1 mod when the app started.
update.launch_checked_plural: Checked {count} mods when the app started.
update.dismissed: You're ignoring this update — the mark is gone from this mod's card. If the author publishes anything newer, it will show up again on its own.

update_apply.title: Update {mod}?
update_apply.overwrite_note: The new files are copied over this mod folder. Files it doesn't replace are left where they are, so anything you added yourself stays.
update_apply.snapshot_note: A copy of this mod as it is now is saved first. You can put it back from the mod's right-click menu.
update_apply.keybind_note: If you rebound any keys inside this mod's .ini, the new version's own file replaces them. The saved copy still has them.
update_apply.patch_warning: This download is a patch: it contains .ini files and none of the {count} file(s) they need, so it expects the mod it patches to already be in this folder. Only its .ini files are being replaced — everything else here is left as it is.
update_apply.unused_folders: The archive also contains {folders}, which isn't part of this mod and won't be installed.
update_apply.remove_stale_why: The new version renamed its .ini. Leaving the old one means two are loaded at once, which usually shows up as broken hotkeys.
update_apply.kept_inis: Left alone: {files} — it belongs to something else in this folder, not to this download.
update_apply.blocked_empty: The download contained no mod folders.
update_apply.blocked_unknown: This mod was installed before the app started recording how archives were unpacked, and this download contains more than one folder — so which one is this mod is something only you can say.
update_apply.blocked_changed: The archive's layout no longer matches how this mod was installed, so writing it over the folder could put files in the wrong place.
update_apply.blocked_hint: Download it from the Marketplace instead and install it as a new mod, then remove the old one once you're happy with it.
update_apply.effects_heading: What this does to the folder
update_apply.done_written_value: {count} file(s) copied into the mod folder
update_apply.done_reactivated: Switched off for the copy, then switched back on
update_apply.keybinds_explainer: The new version shipped its own .ini, which replaced the keys you had. Nothing was carried over — putting a key back automatically risks writing a broken .ini — so set them again with “Edit keybinds” in the mod's right-click menu, or restore the saved copy to get the old file back.
update_apply.rollback_hint: Not what you expected? “Restore a previous version…” in this mod's right-click menu puts it back exactly as it was.
update_apply.mod_missing_title: The mod is no longer there
update_apply.mod_missing: “{mod}” is no longer in your mods folder.
update_apply.snapshot_failed: Couldn't save a copy of “{mod}” first, so nothing was changed. Check that there's free space and that the app data folder is writable.
update_apply.copy_failed: Updating “{mod}” failed part-way: {message}. Restore the saved copy from its right-click menu, and close the game first if it's running.
update_apply.layout_failed: Couldn't work out where the new files go for “{mod}”.

backups.intro: Saved automatically before each update. Restoring copies the old files back; a copy of the current state is saved first, so this can be undone.
backups.empty: There's nothing saved for this mod yet. A copy is saved automatically the first time you update it from inside the app.
backups.confirm_body: “{mod}” will be put back to how it was on {date}. A copy of it as it is right now is saved first, so you can undo this.
